capacity_usable_kwh.notes: mbusa "battery capacity" row, read as usable because a second page labels this same pack usable: the Mercedes release and auto-data.net (per the fact-checker) list 116 kWh net/usable.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: GUESS: no page found names the cathode of this pack (auto-data and auto-motor-und-sport say only lithium-ion; the EV Database EQB excerpt says no data). nmc is the maker-wide norm (EQS/EQE NCM 811, CLA/GLC NMC) but EQB (MFA2) and G 580 (216-cell 116 kWh pack) are different packs. Owner decision needed.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: No page states the G 580 pack voltage; its 200 kW peak and 116 kWh pack look like the 400 V EQS-class pack, and Mercedes introduced 800 V only with the 2026 CLA / 2027 EQS. Weak; owner decision needed.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: no page found for this car (EQB / G 580); the 2026 CLA release states navigation-triggered battery pre-heating and Mercedes states no lineup-wide feature for this model year, so this is a guess from the same maker. Manual control unknown.

ac_max_kw.notes: mbusa maximum AC charging speed. Mercedes-Benz Canada lists 11 kW AC for the 2026 G 580 (mercedes-benz.ca g580w4e page); mbusa lists 9.6 kW. One value is stored for the shared CA/US car: 9.6 (US).
